# Jordan subalgebras generated by a set

The module `PhyslibAlpha.ProbabilisticTheory.JordanOrderUnit.Power.Generated`, [PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean): 24 declarations (5 instances with no name), 16 with a docstring.

> The smallest unital Jordan submodule containing a set, as a Jordan algebra in its own right.

## i. Overview

> The Jordan subalgebra generated by a set of observables is the smallest unital submodule closed
> under the Jordan product containing it. For a single observable it is the span of its powers.

## ii. Key results

> - `JordanAlgebra.generatedBySet` : the generated subalgebra.
> - `JordanAlgebra.GeneratedBySet` : it as a Jordan algebra.

## iv. References

> * None.

## A. Jordan-closed submodules and generation

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.IsJordanSubmodule`**, a def, [line 53](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean#L53).

> A real submodule is Jordan-closed when it contains the unit and is closed under the Jordan
> product.  This is the closure notion used for arbitrary generated Jordan fragments.

```lean

```

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.generatedBySet_le`**, a lemma, [line 91](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean#L91).

> Universal property of arbitrary Jordan generation: every unital Jordan submodule containing
> the generators contains `generatedBySet s`.

```lean
lemma generatedBySet_le {s : Set E} {J : Submodule ℝ E} (hs : s ⊆ J)
    (hJ : IsJordanSubmodule J) : generatedBySet s ≤ J
```

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.generatedBySet_mono`**, a lemma, [line 97](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean#L97).

> Enlarging the generating set can only enlarge its generated Jordan fragment.

```lean
lemma generatedBySet_mono {s t : Set E} (hst : s ⊆ t) :

```

## C. Generation by one observable

**`ProbabilisticTheory.JordanAlgebra.generatedBySet_singleton_eq_generatedByOne`**, a lemma, [line 189](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/2a1dfe43134b49b643642f13d33031754021bb5d/PhyslibAlpha/ProbabilisticTheory/JordanOrderUnit/Power/Generated.lean#L189).

> The subalgebra generated by one observable is the span of its powers.

```lean
lemma generatedBySet_singleton_eq_generatedByOne (a : E) :
    generatedBySet ({a} : Set E) = generatedByOne a
```
